ground_truth.context: Table 2 ("Absolute and relative concentration bias in Main-Treatment"), column 2.  The average absolute measure of concentration bias, d~: the number of additional per-workday real-effort tasks a subject is willing to complete in the unbalanced trade-off beyond the indifference points elicited in the eight balanced trade-offs.  Subjects with an upper corner choice in the unbalanced trade-off are assigned the midpoint between the lower bound (62) and their manually stated indifference point.  Estimated by OLS of d~ on a constant (the sample mean); robust standard errors.  Sample: all Main-Treatment subjects in the main sample, i.e. excluding the preregistered exclusions (subjects with at least one corner choice in the balanced trade-offs).

cell.label: claude-code
deviations_manifest: Upper-corner lower bound set to 63 (the value coded in the data for upper-corner subjects) rather than 62 as written in Section 2.3.5; midpoint = (63 + stated indifference point)/2.

Main sample = no corner choice in any balanced trade-off AND the data's preregistered-sample flag pap_sample==1; the corner rule alone keeps 7 additional subjects (attempt-3) whom the flag excludes for a reason the paper text does not state.

Control conditions: relative measure computed as d~/(e_j + x~_j) for the repeated trade-off j only (the deviation falls on a single workday), instead of the 8-workday average of eq. (12) used for the Treatment conditions.
Tobit (Table 2 col. 4): AER::tobit on the lower-bound d~ with censoring at -63 and 63; OLS columns use lm_robust HC1 robust SEs.
cell.notes: Data: Consumption Experiment/Stata/Consumption_Experiment.csv (9 rows per subject; decisions 1-8 balanced, 9 final). Conditions: pizza==1 & main==1 Main, pizza==1 & main==0 Mechanism, pizza==0 Donation; control==1 Control. x~_t indexed by utility_point; e_t from footnote 3. attempt-1 and attempt-2 were exploratory (variable coding, checking precomputed columns). attempt-3 used the corner rule only (N 202/203 in some Table 3 pairs); check_attempt reported all claims within tolerance, but the paper states 100 subjects per condition, so the final run restricts to pap_sample==1, giving exactly 100 per condition. All 13 claims reproduced to the reported precision; robust SEs also match Tables 2 and 3.
